filterSourceNote.message: Matrices ya simulation oyo esalemi na ba recherches ya Viénot 1999 & Brettel 1997.

infoTooltipText.message: Mode ya simulation elakisaka ndenge nini lokasa etali moto oyo azali na bozangi ya komona langi — ezali na ntina mpo na ba designers oyo bazali komeka mosala na bango. Mode ya correction esalelaka daltonisation mpo na ko déplacer ba couleurs confus na ba ranges oyo ba usagers ya colorblind bakoki ko distinguer facilement.
infoTooltipText.description: Tooltip text explaining the difference between simulation and correction modes.
